state.background: Plan45 proposes B3e as a staged 17-case mobile chart readability migration, with 16 cases in consumption-mobile-readability plus one CPI stacked-area component smoke. The cases are grouped into four execution subbatches (A/B/C/D) of at most three stable rows each, while the one fresh initial JEV plan review covers the whole roadmap. Each subbatch requires focused Browser Mode verification, independent diff review, and a fresh implementation JEV checkpoint before the next; no E2E runs in B3e. B3d contributes 2 of the cadence 20, so passing all B3e cases makes 19/20. Explorer's latest source mapping found no defensible 20th case; the next consolidated E2E must wait for a later valid migrated case and its gates. Preserve A=123/E=90/M=1 and do not include the 768/769 page-shell-dependent cases.
acceptanceCriteria: B3e contains exactly 17 new named Browser Mode cases: 8 nominal/real spending chart geometry cases (four widths), 2 EarningsBreakdownChart/CustomTooltip bounds cases, 6 nominal/real internal-scroll cases (three viewports), and 1 actual CPI StackedAreaChart area-path component smoke.

The four geometry widths map to stable rows p45-b-consumption-mobile-readability-52-{320px,375px,390px,430px}-y-x. Each width has separate nominal/real actual SpendingBarChart cases transferring only P42-203–207, P42-209–213, and P42-215–217. Keep P42-202 and P42-218 in E2E; keep P42-208 tick-domain and P42-214 quarter-format assertions outside the slice and in Playwright. Do not include 768/769 cases.

The two earnings tooltip rows are p45-b-consumption-mobile-readability-191-375px-tooltip-6-viewport and the corresponding 430px row. Use actual EarningsBreakdownChart and actual CustomTooltip at 375x667 and 430x667. Transfer P42-230 and P42-232–240 viewport bounds only. Retain P42-219–229 route/chart activation and content assertions, and retain P42-231 because its expect mixes row-value presence with label-measurement behavior.

The three tooltip scroll rows are p45-b-consumption-mobile-readability-297-375x667-tooltip, -320x480-tooltip, and -landscape-tooltip. Each has distinct nominal/real actual SpendingBarChart/CustomTooltip cases with enough fixture series to overflow. Transfer P42-246–248 and P42-250–260 only. Retain P42-241–244 activation/route/exact-key assertions and P42-261 post-close behavior. P42-245 remains covered by existing CustomTooltip unit coverage; P42-249 has no current E2E assertion and is already unit-owned; do not duplicate either.

The CPI case maps stable row p45-a-cpi-sections and P42-262 only: mount actual StackedAreaChart in the existing MonthlyBoundaryAxis Browser Mode fixture and assert an area path renders. Keep #section-stacked route visibility in its Playwright smoke and retain existing route/scroll E2E elsewhere.

The roadmap is staged as A=3 rows/6 tests, B=3 rows/4 tests, C=3 rows/6 tests, D=1 row/1 test. After each, focused verification and independent diff review precede a fresh implementation JEV checkpoint. Use one initial plan review for the roadmap; do not add a repeated plan call per subbatch.

B3d accounts for 2/20 from the last consolidated E2E. B3e contributes 17 and reaches only 19/20 after all pass. The next consolidated E2E waits for another defensible plan-reviewed case to reach 20/20 and pass its gates. No E2E/targeted Playwright/full E2E command runs during B3e. A=123/E=90/M=1 remains unchanged; no stable row becomes fully migrated and M does not increase.

Current Browser fixtures are narrower than proposed: SpendingBarChart mobile uses 412x915 and two/three categories; earnings tooltip uses a simplified test tooltip at 1280x800; MonthlyBoundaryAxis already mounts actual StackedAreaChart with synthetic data. Proposals must use actual component CSS, deterministic fixture data sized for the contracts, and actual CustomTooltip where asserted; they must not claim route, production data, or page-shell coverage.
verification: Explorer/source audit confirms four width-loop inputs at 320/375/390/430 with nominal/real loop executions. The selected geometry assertions are P42-203–207, P42-209–213, and P42-215–217. P42-208 and P42-214 are value-domain/label-format checks; P42-202 section and P42-218 document overflow are route-owned.

The 375px and 430px earnings tooltip rows share one E2E test body loop; P42-219–229 are activation/content assertions; P42-230 and P42-232–240 are box-presence/bounds; P42-231 is a mixed nonempty value and label-measure assertion and remains Playwright-owned.

The internal-scroll source loops nominal/real for three viewports. Mapped CSS and scroll geometry is P42-246–248 and P42-250–260; P42-241–244 activation/key/content and P42-261 close behavior stay E2E. P42-245 is unit-owned; P42-249 is absent from current E2E and a unit test checks the safe-area declaration.

P42-262 is the area path visible expect in the cpi-chart-categories route smoke, separate from the same test's #section-stacked route visibility expect. Existing Browser Mode MonthlyBoundaryAxis mounts real StackedAreaChart with deterministic synthetic data.
knownConstraints: The current E2E tests include production routes and production data; Browser Mode fixtures prove actual components with deterministic props only. Preserve route, data activation/content, section visibility, and document scroll assertions as mapped.

The current EarningsBreakdownChart Browser Mode test uses simplified tooltip content and cannot be reused as evidence for actual CustomTooltip bounds without replacing that content in the new viewport fixtures.

B3e is plan scope only: no implementation or test result is claimed. After B3e implementation there remains one case before the consolidated E2E cadence threshold; the current source audit has not identified that case.
state.outputRequirement: Review the concrete 17-case staged roadmap. Select exactly one criterion from the supplied choices. If the verdict is not valid_as_defined, give a case-specific finding and affected stable row/assertion, observed evidence or exact neededEvidence, a concrete proposedFix/nextAction, and remainingUncertainty. Do not authorize E2E at 19/20, increment M, or broaden to the excluded 768/769 cases.

plan.instructions: Select exactly one mutually exclusive criterion for this B3e plan checkpoint.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The staged 17-case plan is sufficiently specified and respects the mapped E2E/unit boundaries and cadence.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: The proposed source ownership or retained guarantees contradict an applicable requirement.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: Prerequisite information needed to judge the roadmap is missing.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: The proposal lacks detail needed to assess feasibility or scope.
criteria.implementation_issue: A concrete component/source constraint invalidates the proposed plan.
criteria.scope_violation: The proposal exceeds the selected assertion slices, widens scope, or violates the 20-case E2E cadence.
criteria.other: A material planning issue does not fit the other criteria.
criteria.indeterminate: Available evidence does not support a reliable determination.
